channel.description: World Walkers: Cog is weekly podcast that follows the exploits of a mismatched group of adventurers on the Steam-Powered world of Cog.
channel.itunes:author: Pedro Galicia

item.title: Lost Episode – Can’t Feel My Funk
item.description:
For those that don’t know, my brother Frank passed away recently. I want to make sure all of his recordings are out there so that those that want to hear him have the opportunity. This episode is an oldie from back before World Walkers: Cog was a podcast. We recorded this and I think we shared it once, but it was taken down.
Now I’m sharing it again. I hope you enjoy listening to him again.

item.title: Side Adventure – Jiggles’ Day Out! – E2
item.description:
In our last episode, our cast of canines found themselves in the house of Jiggles, only to find their noses rubbed in some trouble. Several bad dogs were discovered to be tearing up the house, and it’s up to the Dog Crew to find out why!

Let’s sniff around and find out what happens in our newest episode!

There’s one more note I should add. There’s a point in this episode where I’m just broken. See if you can find out where it happens.

item.title: Side Adventure – Jiggles’ Day Out! – E1
item.description:
At long last, the long-awaited story of Jiggles’ Day Out!

Back in the beginning of Season One of World Walkers: Cog, Sabin had a little Porgi of a dog named Jiggles. When Sabin left Falas, he left Jiggles on his own. But what happened to him? And how do we find out??

The answer is canine characters. Of course.

Join the Cog Crew as they each play a different dog-based character and explore a completely different side of the Steam-Powered World of Cog…

Not only that, but the Captain has to Nova that he has a Gunslinger’s weapon, a possession that carries with it a death sentence from any follower of the Creed.

item.title: Off The Rails – S1:E18
item.description:
Anyone who’s played in an ongoing campaign has experienced this. You miss a couple of games. You’re dying to get the group back together. And then finally, everyone’s back at the table. And you’d think you’d be ready to break out the dice and jump back into the game.

What happens instead is everybody’s so excited to hang out again that you’re lucky if you even play that night. We sat down and recorded for over two hours this session. I’ma tell you up front: I got much less than two hours of World Walkers: Cog.

That’s why I’m calling this one Episode Eighteen – Off The Rails…

item.title: Outtakes – Cog Vs. Yu-Gi-Oh
item.description:
Normally, I try to balance out our episodes with a good balance of in-game story and table talk. I want our podcast to feel like you’re at our game, hanging with us, but you’re also in the story, feeling what the players feel when they’re immersed in the world. To keep that balance, sometimes I have to save something for the outtakes at the end of the episode.

That all changed with Episode Six: Dayturnal. We had conversations that were too off-topic to keep in the episode, but when I put them together at the end, it was way too much to just tack on afterwards. So I decided to leave a bit for Dayturnal, and save the rest for this episode.

So enjoy this bonus outtake episode of World Walkers: Cog. Inside you’ll find talk of My Hero Acadamia, hate crimes against music, and a breakdown of Yu-Gi-Oh that left me with a lot of questions.

item.title: Fun In Falas – S1:E1
item.description:
What’s up everyone? I’m Pedro, the DM and Creator of the World Walkers Universe, a homebrew series of worlds that I’ve been telling stories in for over twenty years. In my other podcast, World Walkers, a group of adventurers are traveling between worlds, looking for the shattered remains of a dream island that can drive back the nightmares that threaten to tear existence apart. One of the worlds they visited was the Steam-Powered World of Cog, where Airships travel the skies, Dwarven Brotherhoods control the secrets of technological progress, druids plot to rip society back to a more primitive, simpler time, and far to the east, past the shattered land masses frozen in dead magic, secrets of the arcane lie protected by a kingdom desperate to rebuild itself from a war lost by sabotage.

This is the setting for World Walkers: Cog, a weekly podcast that follows a group of adventurers as they explore the world of Cog. Let’s let the group introduce themselves.

New episodes of World Walkers: Cog are available every Thursday. You can also look for World Walkers wherever you enjoy listening to podcasts if you want to find out what the other podcast is like.

If you love what you hear and want to listen to the next episode, go for it! I uploaded the first three episodes right away, so binge! Please let me know what you think by either hitting me up on Twitter @worldwalkerspod or leaving us a review on iTunes!

Alright, so let’s get into it. Here’s the first episode of World Walkers: Cog.
